newsitem.title: USA: Firm in share buy pact with North East.
newsitem.headline: Firm in share buy pact with North East.

text.p: Ballantrae Partners LLC, a New York-based investment firm, said on Tuesday that it has agreed to buy shares that could give it up to a 29 percent stake in North East Insurance Co.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the partnership said that, under an August 23 agreement with North East, it agreed to buy trust shares representing 810,000 common shares of the company and up to 400,000 common shares from a private placement of 1.2 million shares.

The trust shares will be purchased for about $749,250, while the shares in the placement offering will be bought for not more than $1.25 a share. The agreement is subject to certain conditions, according to the filing.
Under the agreement, after the purchase of the trust shares, Ballantrae will be entitled to nominate three directors to the board.
In return, Ballantrae agreed, among other things, not to participate any proxy drive deemed to be an "election contest" in North East.
It also agreed not to raise its take to more than 30 percent without prior board consent except in response to an unsolicited tender offer of an unrelated third party.
